statement: Original October 5 announcement scheduled October 12–25, 2026 Chapter One testing; the end date was superseded by October 26 extension through November 9 (F11). Request Access on store.

Original known as Outcry; fixed screens replaced by free 3D exploration, locations expanded, puzzles revised; Anthesteria remains.

statement: October 16 official announcement reports five live playtest fixes: English diary voice-over ending, low-settings item red glow, Steam Deck gamepad detection and cutscenes, last-page note hint, and New Game progress-reset warning. No puzzle combinations or Steam Deck Verified rating are established.
source_title: 100,000 Wishlists for Sublustrum. Minor Playtest Fixes.

statement: October 26 official announcement extends the Chapter One open playtest through November 9, 2026, superseding October 25. Developers expect one or two more patches before it ends; no cutoff hour, timezone or new puzzle answers are specified.
source_title: Sublustrum Open Playtest Extended Until November 9
conflicting_evidence: October 5/12 announcements stated October 25; superseded by this extension.
